scale.meaning: positive = conditions broadly improving; negative = broadly deteriorating; zero = neutral

method: Total is the equal-weighted average of the four component scores, each mapped onto the -100..+100 diffusion scale.

equity_breadth.formula: (share of the public-equity constituents above their own 12-month moving average - 0.5) * 200

sector_breadth.formula: (count of the 4 plain cap-weighted sector indices above their own 12-month moving average / 4 - 0.5) * 200

private_capital.formula: month-on-month trend of the private-capital index * private_capital_k, clamped to -100..100

commodity_stress.formula: -1 * month-on-month direction of the commodities index * commodity_stress_k, clamped to -100..100 (inverted: rising input cost = deteriorating)

calibration.note: One scaling constant per trend component, fitted to each series' historical monthly volatility so a typical monthly move lands mid-scale rather than pinning the ends. Construction parameters, not external claims; null until the calculator fits them.

reading_schema.month: string, YYYY-MM (one row per calendar month)
reading_schema.total: number, -100..100 — equal-weighted mean of the four component scores
